summary: Iteration 16 verified one-time game tickets and score validation. Backend: full pytest suite (-n 0) passed 281/281 in 61s. Frontend E2E at 375x667 with a seeded TEST user: (1) Classic game via UI -> /games/start 200, /scores 200, classic-total-card total=100. Reload -> /scores 409, 'Skor sesi ini sudah tercatat sebelumnya.' shown, DB still games=1 score=100. /leaderboard Classic shows TEST user with 100, which matches. A 2nd Classic game raised the total to 200 (cumulative works). (2) Crafted /result?mode=classic&score=5000&correct=10&total=10 without game_id -> no POST /scores, 'Skor sesi ini tidak bisa dikirim.' shown. With fake game_id -> 409 and 'sudah tercatat' shown. (3) Time Attack -> ticket + 200 submit, success message shown. (4) Tournament Classic (enabled temporarily with a TEST admin) -> 200, tournament-result-card shows 1390 and rank #1 with +10 Royal. Reload -> 409. Tournament was disabled again, all TEST data was cleaned up and 'Tos Joki' was not touched. Core fix works. Found 1 medium issue (Time Attack correct/total is wrong) and several minor ones.

minor.issue: Tickets are unlimited and have no minimum play time or rate limit. A script can call start->scores in a loop and add up to 1000 points (10 correct x 100) to the Classic cumulative total per call with no real play. The cap only limits the damage per call. Consider a minimum elapsed time (e.g. now - started_at >= N s) and/or a per-user rate limit.

Accepts any score from the client with no game ticket. A crafted /result?challenge=X&score=99999 marks the challenge as beaten and sends a notification to the challenger. This existed before this iteration but works around the same anti-cheat goal.
The ticket is marked used before the tournament_closed 403 check, so the ticket is wasted. Harmless, noted for completeness.

ui_bugs.issue: In Time Attack, total = useCorrect + (useIndex - useCorrect) = indexRef, and indexRef resets to 0 whenever the queue reshuffles. Observed URL: correct=16&total=7. result.tsx clamps total to max(total, correct), so the UI showed SALAH 0 and 100% accuracy, and the DB stored correct=16 total=16, even though many answers were wrong. Fix: keep an answeredCount ref that increments in choose() and use it as total.

Without a game_id the score is correctly not sent, but updateLocalHigh still runs. A crafted URL sets the local high score to 5000, shows 'REKOR BARU!' and plays the trumpet. Skip the local-high/record logic when there is no game_id, or when the submit returns 409 for a logged-in user.

Any error from /auth/me, including a network abort during navigation, calls setToken(null) and logs the user out. Reproduced: /auth/me was ERR_ABORTED, the token was wiped, then /games/start returned 401 and the result showed 'Masuk untuk kirim skor'. Only clear the token on 401.

issues: Two status cards appear together: the red 'sudah tercatat'/'tidak bisa dikirim' card AND a 'Skor tidak terkirim.' card with a green cloud-done icon. They repeat each other and the green success icon contradicts the error. Show a single card.
After a reload, the Tournament card still renders with value '-'. Hide it or show a better state.
The submit status/error cards have no testID (suggest submit-status, submit-error).

action_items: MEDIUM: Fix Time Attack total in quiz.tsx. Track the number of answered questions in a ref instead of using indexRef, which resets on reshuffle.
Consider a minimum play time and/or rate limit for game tickets, so scripted start->submit loops cannot inflate the Classic cumulative total.
Require a game ticket, or check against the ticket's submitted score, for /challenges/{id}/complete.
result.tsx: skip updateLocalHigh / REKOR BARU / trumpet when there is no game_id or the submit gets a 409. Combine the duplicate status cards and add testIDs submit-status / submit-error.
auth.tsx: only clear the stored token when /auth/me returns 401, not on network errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Ticket consume uses an atomic find_one_and_update with user_id+mode+used=False. The race is safe and mode mismatch is rejected.
game_sessions has a TTL index (24h) and a unique game_id index. Good.
server.py is 2610 lines; it should be split into routers (scores, tournament, admin, news, etc.).
Earlier test files (iter14/iter15) did not clean up game_sessions for TEST_ users (56 orphan tickets). The tester removed them; their fixtures should add game_sessions to cleanup.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/seed_iter16_fe.py (new helper: seed|state|cleanup for FE E2E users)

Navigating too fast aborts /auth/me, and auth.tsx then wipes the token. Use `python /app/backend/tests/seed_iter16_fe.py seed|state|cleanup`. Admin toggle: PUT /api/admin/tournament {enabled}. Writing to frontend source via bash was blocked by the harness.
rca_of_issue: TA total bug: quiz.tsx finish() computes total from indexRef.current, which is set back to 0 by setIndex(0) when the 50-question queue runs out and reshuffles. Wrong answers are therefore lost, and result.tsx's Math.max(total, correct) hides this as 100% accuracy.
